text:
Marta: Heads-up — we need a rapid battlecard + webinar hook refresh before the Q2 launch. Goal: 3 quick soundbites vs cloud AI platforms, 2 vs LLM APIs, and a short infra vendor rebut. Can we sync and lock copy today?
Sam: +1, rough plan: webinar headline, a 1-slide benchmark highlight, and a routing plan for incoming leads.
Leo: For benchmarks let's lean on latency/cost-per-token and predictable SLOs — those hit product managers and infra teams.
Ashley: Agree. Need one human-friendly stat vs cloud: e.g., "up to 3x cost reduction at 95th percentile" — is that defensible?
Marta: We have the internal perf deck. I'll extract a safe phrasing: "consistently lower per-token cost under production mixes" — not exact multiple unless we cite config.
Ben: Sales wants quick rebuts: 2-line soundbites for objection "we already use cloud provider X" and "we can't manage ops". Drafted: "Unified runtime + smart routing keeps your app on the fastest, cheapest path without building ops from scratch."
Sam: Nice. For cloud provider objection, add: "We integrate with their infra — keep the control plane you need; avoid vendor lock while optimizing cost."
Leo: For LLM API competitors, lead with: "same dev API, better economics and rollout controls" — call out canary rollouts, pinning, and KV-caching as signals.
Ashley: Webinar hook ideas: 1) "Serving-first: how to cut inference costs without sacrificing latency" 2) "Benchmark mythbusting: cloud vs managed inference in real apps" 3) "From prototype to 99.9% uptime — rollout stories"
Marta: Pick 1 and 2 for the webinar. We need a 30s opener and two CTAs (sales demo, self-serve trial).
Ben: On routing — SalesOps wants lead rules. Proposed snippet:```json
{ "lead_routing": [ { "condition": "annual_spend > 250k", "route_to": "AE" }, { "condition": "region == 'EMEA' && product_interest == 'Dedicated'", "route_to": "EMEA_AE" }, { "condition": "utm_campaign == 'webinar_q2'", "route_to": "Inbound_Webinar" }, { "condition": "confidence == 'low'", "route_to": "SDR" } ] }
```
Sam: Can SalesOps/Ben own final routing? We'll wire it into HubSpot and mark "webinar_q2" as high-priority.
SalesOps: We'll own it. Ben, can you add score thresholds? Prefer numeric for automation.
Ben: Will do. Also plan a follow-up sequence: 3-touch email + 1 SDR call within 72h for demo-likely leads.
Marta: Copy asks — need 3 short battlecard lines per competitor: cloud AI, LLM API, infra vendor. Keep it punchy (<18 words) and include a supporting fact line.
Leo: I'll draft cloud AI lines emphasizing "predictable SLOs" and "grading models for production mixes".
Ashley: I'll do LLM API lines: "drop-in API compatibility" + "rollouts & KV-cache advantages".
Sam: Timeline: drafts by EOD, internal review tomorrow 10am, final to design for slide assets by 3pm.
Dev-bot: Reminder — webinar landing page published to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/webinar-q2 (deployed 1799998905).
Marta: Perfect. Once drafts in, I'll run a quick legal sweep for any competitor mentions. If anyone needs data slices from infra team, ping @leo.
Ben: Adding one more ask from SDRs — a 1-pager cheat for rebuts (copy+talking points). I'll collate post-review.
Ashley: Quick creative ask — can we get a 6-word headline option for ads? I have: "Serve faster, pay less, stay predictable." Thoughts?
Sam: Good. Alternative: "Production inference that scales — affordably."
Marta: Both solid. We'll A/B in the landing page test. Ok team — drop drafts in this thread and @Marta when ready. :thumbsup:
